messages:
sam: deploy-bot finished rolling v3.0.0 to prod at 2025-06-12T14:05:09Z

deploy-bot: [system] rollout complete: release=v3.0.0 stage=prod status=success duration=14m

megan: running post-deploy synths now. Seeing a handful of 503s on /v1/embed and two probe timeouts (30s) from the eu1 probe cluster. p95 jumped from 180ms -> 720ms.

infra-bot: infra alert: inference-runtime(quantized) node count=3 reported "insufficient shard availability" for model=embed-small.

sre-lead: Can we avoid a full rollback? Route pinning to previous version would be ideal. Is route-level pin supported via redwoodctl?

paul: yes. redwoodctl supports route pin and soft pin (traffic shift with immediate fallback). Command: `redwoodctl routes pin --route /v1/embed --to-version v2.9.7 --soft`

sam: deploy-bot, please apply a soft pin to /v1/embed -> v2.9.7 and hold further stage rollouts for 45m.

deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl routes pin --route /v1/embed --to-version v2.9.7 --soft --hold 45m`

deploy-bot: [success] soft-pin applied. traffic shift started. estimated shift time=12s.

megan: after pin, next three synthetic samples returned 200 and p95 is back to ~210ms. No more timeouts so far. :relieved:

paul: capturing runtime dumps from the three quant nodes and saving probe payloads to ticket INF-2471. Also collecting kernel selection traces; suspect fallback to slower kernels for long sequences.

infra-bot: note: two nodes show elevated CPU on quant-lib threads during the failure window.

sre-lead: Good mitigation. Marking this incident as sev-3 (partial impact, mitigated by pin). No customer-impact page.

qa-bot: checklist: attach probe traces, failing request bodies, runtime dumps, and confirm soft-pin in release notes.

sam: opening INF-2471 and assigning to eng-runtime (owners: paul, megan). Will schedule follow-up meeting if root cause is code-level.

megan: suggestion: run small A/B with modelvariant=nonquant on 1% of traffic in eu1 to validate whether quantization path is the root cause before reverting pin. Thoughts?

paul: +1, can do a constrained canary: `redwoodctl traffic split --route /v1/embed --variant nonquant --percent 1 --duration 10m`

sre-lead: OK to validate, but keep probe watch and auto-rollback if error rate >1% or p95 >500ms.

sam: agreed. I'll run the canary in 10m. Leave channel open for updates.
